notice.title: Legal notice
notice.lead: Who publishes this site, and who hosts it.

sections.title: Publisher
body: This site is a personal project, published by a private individual and offered free of charge. It carries out no commercial activity.
First name of the publisher and editorial director: Matthias.
French law lets a non-professional publisher withhold their full identity, provided it has been given to the host, who can pass it to the judicial authority. That is the case here.

sections.title: Site hosting
body: The pages you are reading are served by Netlify, Inc., 512 2nd Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.

sections.title: Hosting of accounts and data
body: Accounts, plants and the database are hosted in France by o2switch, 222-224 boulevard Gustave Flaubert, 63000 Clermont-Ferrand, France, phone +33 4 44 44 60 40.
The plant photos you add and the emails the site sends are handled by that same infrastructure.

sections.title: Ownership
body: The code, text and images of this site are the work of its publisher. Species names come from public botanical databases.
You may quote and share these pages freely. Any commercial reuse requires prior agreement.

sections.title: Reporting content
body: To report content you believe unlawful, or for any question about this notice, write to the address below. You will get a reply within a reasonable time.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What the site knows about you, why, and for how long.

sections.title: In short
body: This site has no advertising trackers, no analytics, and passes nothing to anyone for commercial purposes. There is no cookie banner because there is nothing to make you accept.
The only data kept is what you enter to manage your own plant collection.

sections.title: What is stored on the server
body: Your account: email address, name if you give one, a hash of your password — never the password itself —, a Google identifier if you sign in that way, chosen language, dates of creation and confirmation.
Your plants: the name you give them, the species, any description you add, the photos you upload, the watering rhythm and the watering history.
Your problem reports: your message, the severity you picked, the page involved, your browser, your screen size and your language.

sections.title: What never leaves your device
body: To work offline, the app keeps a copy of its pages and files in your browser's memory. That copy holds no personal data, and clearing the site's data erases it.

sections.title: Why this data is processed
body: The account and the plants are needed for the service you ask for: keeping your collection and reminding you to water. Without an account, nothing is kept.
Reports are kept to fix the problems people run into, which is the legitimate interest of keeping the site working.

sections.title: For how long
body: Your account and your plants are kept as long as the account exists, and erased when it is deleted.
An address-confirmation link lasts twenty-four hours, a password-reset link one hour. After that they are unusable and deleted.
A session lasts thirty days, or until you sign out.
Reports are kept as long as they help fix the problem described.

sections.title: Who else has access
body: Nobody. No data is sold, rented, or passed to third parties for commercial purposes.

Three providers are involved technically: o2switch, in France, which hosts the database and the photos and sends the emails; Netlify, in the United States, which serves the pages; and Google, if and only if you choose to sign in with a Google account — Google then passes us your address, your name and your identifier.

As Netlify is a US company, serving the pages involves a transfer outside the European Union. Those pages contain no personal data: your plants never pass through them, they are requested straight from the French server.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
body: Three cookies, not one more. The session one keeps you signed in for thirty days; it is out of reach of JavaScript and only travels over HTTPS. A temporary ten-minute cookie protects the Google sign-in against request forgery. The last one remembers the language you chose.
These three cookies are strictly necessary to the operation or are a display preference: the rules exempt them from consent, which is why no banner is forced on you.
The browser's local storage keeps the offline copy described above.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to see the data about you, to correct it, to erase it, to receive a copy, or to object to its processing.
Write to the address below: your request will be handled within one month. Deleting an account erases the account and the plants stored under it.
If the answer does not satisfy you, you can refer the matter to the French data-protection authority (CNIL), 3 place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris.

sections.title: Security
body: Everything travels over end-to-end HTTPS. Passwords are kept as a hash, never in the clear. The database is reachable only from the server that uses it, never from the internet.
No system is perfectly safe. If you find a flaw, please write to us rather than publish it.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: What the site offers, and what it does not promise.

sections.title: Purpose
body: This site lets you, free of charge, manage a collection of indoor plants: record them, track their watering and look up their species. It is meant for private individuals, for personal use.
Using it means accepting these terms.

sections.title: This is not expert advice
body: The species names offered and the watering reminders are indications, drawn from public botanical databases and the information you give. They are pointers, not certainties: an identification can be wrong.

Never eat a plant, handle it, or use it medicinally on the strength of this site alone. Some indoor plants are toxic to people and to animals alike. When in doubt, ask a professional; if a plant is swallowed, contact a poison-control centre or a doctor.
This site is no substitute for a botanist, a vet or a doctor.

sections.title: Your account
body: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for what is done from your account. Tell us if you think it has been used without your consent.
The content you add must be yours and must not infringe anyone else's rights.

sections.title: Availability
body: This site is a personal project, offered with no guarantee of availability or continuity. It may be interrupted, changed or stopped at any time, without notice.
The app stays viewable offline once visited; signing in to an account, on the other hand, needs internet access.

sections.title: Liability
body: The publisher cannot be held responsible for the consequences of using the information published, for any loss of data, or for any unavailability of the service.
This limit does not apply in case of intentional fault or bodily harm, as the law provides.

sections.title: Ending use
body: You may stop using the site at any time and ask for your account to be deleted. The publisher may close an account in case of plainly abusive use.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought before any action; failing that, the French courts have jurisdiction.
